30:410.name: Navbar
30:410.description: The top bar. Dedal: navbar + slots links (many), actions (many).

30:402.name: Hero
30:402.description: The top of a landing page. Dedal: hero { title, lead, install } + slots badge (one), actions (many), media (one).

29:427.name: Image
29:427.description: A picture (image fill on the instance) and its alt text. Dedal: image { alt, src }.

29:422.name: Grid
29:422.description: Items in rows, wrapping. Dedal: grid with children.

3:148.name: FeatureCard
3:148.description: Card + CardHeader composition (shadcn). Dedal contract: feature { title, description, icon }.

29:442.name: Step
29:442.description: A numbered step. Dedal: step { number, title, description }.

29:424.name: Split
29:424.description: Two columns: content and media. Dedal: split with slots content (many) and media (one).

29:448.name: CodeBlock
29:448.description: A code sample with its file name. Dedal: codeBlock { filename, code }.

30:418.name: CTA
30:418.description: A closing call to action. Dedal: cta { title, lead } + slot actions (many).

30:422.name: Footer
30:422.description: The bottom bar. Dedal: footer { tagline } + slot links (many).

29:429.name: Link
29:429.description: A text link. Dedal: link { label }.

3:136.name: Button
3:136.description: shadcn/ui <Button variant size>. Label → children, Icon right → <ArrowRight/>.

29:404.name: Section
29:404.description: A page section: background tone, content in the slot. Dedal: section { tone } with children.

29:421.name: SectionHeading
29:421.description: Eyebrow badge (slot), title and subtitle. Dedal: sectionHeading { title, subtitle, align, tone } + slot badge.

29:441.name: CheckItem
29:441.description: A list item with a check mark. Dedal: checkItem { text, tone }.
